content.summary: The framing correctly distinguishes a refinement of a pinned formal development from a new extremal bound. I compared the manuscript with the supplied primary-source representations, including the preprint definitions, its reported intersecting maximum, its enumeration setup, and its formalization scope. The manuscript explicitly acknowledges that its hypothetical 28-member class is empty if the external computer-assisted result is accepted. This makes the contribution a smaller target for a separate checked exclusion, without treating I(27) as globally open. No material framing defect was found in this bounded comparison.

findings.statement: The supplied passages support the comparison with these specific sources, but cannot establish priority for either the support inequality or the nine-triple completion argument across the literature.
findings.disposition: Retain the manuscript's explicit limitation on global originality and its description of proposed strengthenings relative to the pinned development.

checks.scope: Source identity, definitions, and extremal-status framing
checks.method: Verified the inspected manuscript digest and canonical snapshot digest; verified E16 and E17 byte digests; compared E16 lines 53–61, 85–113 with the manuscript conventions and reference [3].
checks.observation: Author list, title, version, date, distinct petals, and empty-core convention agree. The source uses intersection of distinct members; the manuscript discloses its stronger reflexive interface, which agrees for positive rank. The reported intersecting maximum 27 is attributed rather than presented as a new result.

checks.scope: Finite-reduction contribution and formalization priority limits
checks.method: Compared E17 arXiv section 6.3 and section 8 passages with A1K T7/T8 passages and the manuscript's scope paragraphs.
checks.observation: The 85-point support argument already occurs in the preprint; A1K explicitly claims the checked transport equivalence. E17 separates computational upper bounds from the stated Lean scope. The manuscript respects those distinctions and keeps both profile exclusions as outstanding inputs. No independent check of the external enumeration was performed.
